name: Romance / investment grooming (multi-day, replayed at demo speed)
notes: Slow-burn shape: rapid intimacy -> secrecy -> investment pitch -> payment redirection. Score climbs gradually — timeline must show stage progression, not a single keyword.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Salam! Wrong number lagta hai, lekin aap se baat hoke acha laga. Main Ahmed, Dubai mein kaam karta hoon.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Salam. Koi baat nahi. Main Sana, Karachi se.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sana ji, aap ki profile dekh kar laga aap bohot different hain. Subah gym jate ho? Main bhi daily 5am uthta hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aaj office mein meeting thi, aap yaad aa rahi thi. Pata nahi kyun 😊

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haha, aap bohot funny ho Ahmed.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sach kahoon? Aap se zyada close kisi ko mehsoos nahi kiya itne dinon mein. Yeh baat sirf tum se share kar raha hoon, kisi ko na batana.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Main ne ek trading group join kiya hai — gold signals. Mere cousin ne 2 mahine mein apni car ke paisay double kar liye. Guaranteed returns hain, risk zero.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Double? Yeh to risky lagta hai...

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bilkul nahi! Dekho screenshot bhejta hoon, mere account mein profit dikh raha hai. Sirf aap ke liye bata raha hoon, warna group full ho jata.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aaj last day hai entry ka. Bas 50,000 rupay is Easypaisa agent account par bhej dein: 0345-XXXXXXX. Manager account number de raha hai kyunki direct band hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Theek hai... kitna time lagega profit dikhne mein?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 24 ghante! Aur agar aap abhi kisi ko na batayein aur turant bhejein, to main personal VIP slot dilwa doonga. Time nahi hai Sana, 10 minute ke andar bhejo.
